title: Mother and Child Reading in Backyard, 1956 Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming black-and-white deckle-edge snapshot from August 1956 showing a woman seated in a wicker chair on a lawn next to a child, both smiling and looking intently into an open book or album. The setting is beside a mid-century home with a window and shrubbery in the background, evoking wholesome post-war domestic family life in suburban America.
